The transform path and cache boundary are in Jest’s `ScriptTransformer` and `babel-jest`; Babel resolves the effective plugin/config objects, but `babel-jest` hashes their serialized options—not installed package contents or lockfile resolution.

Relevant files:

- [sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0:packages/jest-runtime/src/index.ts?L1605-L1629](/r/github.com/sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0/-/blob/packages/jest-runtime/src/index.ts?L1605-L1629) - `Runtime.transformFile()` reads source and invokes `ScriptTransformer.transform()`.
- [sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0:packages/jest-transform/src/ScriptTransformer.ts?L142-L174](/r/github.com/sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0/-/blob/packages/jest-transform/src/ScriptTransformer.ts?L142-L174) - `_getCacheKey()` constructs transform options and calls the transformer’s `getCacheKey`; the final Jest key includes file data, filename, Jest config, instrumentation, and transformer key.
- [sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0:packages/jest-transform/src/ScriptTransformer.ts?L482-L535](/r/github.com/sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0/-/blob/packages/jest-transform/src/ScriptTransformer.ts?L482-L535) - `transformSource()` computes the cache path, reads cached output when `config.cache` is enabled, and only invokes `transformer.process()` on a miss.
- [sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0:packages/jest-transform/src/ScriptTransformer.ts?L538-L600](/r/github.com/sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0/-/blob/packages/jest-transform/src/ScriptTransformer.ts?L538-L600) - Async equivalent, including `getCacheKeyAsync` and cached-output short circuit.
- [sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0:packages/babel-jest/src/index.ts?L71-L103](/r/github.com/sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0/-/blob/packages/babel-jest/src/index.ts?L71-L103) - `getCacheKeyFromConfig()` hashes babel-jest source, `JSON.stringify(babelOptions.options)`, source text, relative path, Jest `configString`, config paths, instrumentation, `NODE_ENV`, `BABEL_ENV`, and Node version.
- [sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0:packages/babel-jest/src/index.ts?L105-L148](/r/github.com/sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0/-/blob/packages/babel-jest/src/index.ts?L105-L148) - `loadBabelConfig()` calls Babel `loadPartialConfig`; `loadBabelOptions()` consumes the resolved options and adds Istanbul instrumentation.
- [sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0:packages/babel-jest/src/index.ts?L151-L216](/r/github.com/sg-evals/jest--v29.7.0/-/blob/packages/babel-jest/src/index.ts?L151-L216) - `createTransformer().getCacheKey()` merges Jest/Babel options, loads the partial config, then delegates to `getCacheKeyFromConfig()`.
- [sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-core/src/config/index.ts?L26-L30](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-core/src/config/index.ts?L26-L30) - Babel exports `loadPartialConfig` implementation from `partial.ts`.

- [sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-core/src/config/full.ts?L59-L75](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-core/src/config/full.ts?L59-L75) - `loadFullConfig()` obtains the partial config and begins resolving plugin/preset passes.

- [sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0:packages/babel-plugin-transform-runtime/src/index.ts?L94-L100](/r/github.com/sg-evals/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel--v7.24.0/-/blob/packages/babel-plugin-transform-runtime/src/index.ts?L94-L100) - documents the regenerator-runtime behavior boundary in the plugin.

A lockfile-only resolution change can leave `JSON.stringify(babelOptions.options)` and all other hashed inputs unchanged even though the loaded plugin implementation differs. Jest therefore reuses the old transformed artifact. The first run after the dependency change may pass because it creates or encounters output generated with the old/new implementation; the subsequent run hits the persisted cache and skips Babel processing, exposing the incompatible stale output (`regeneratorRuntime` reference). Clearing the cache forces a fresh transform and repeats the cycle.
